title: WHAT WE DO
missionSubtitle: At Let’s Do It! Vietnam, we’re on a mission to transform our beautiful country into a cleaner, greener haven.
differenceSubtitle: Here's how we make a difference:
card1Desc: Create a positive impact on the environment by mobilizing millions of volunteers in Vietnam.
card2Desc: Empower individuals to make informed choices and take action for a greener planet
card3Desc: Drive meaningful change and inspire others to join the cause.
card4Desc: Emphasizing responsible consumption, waste reduction, and eco-friendly choices
